newsitem.title: USA: American Stock Exchange volume up 10.8 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: American Stock Exchange volume up 10.8 pct in 1996.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange on Tuesday said equity trading volume reached 5.62 billion shares in 1996, a 10.8 percent increase over the previous year.
It was the second consecutive year in which volume surpassed five billion shares, the exchange said. Volume in 1995 amounted to 5.07 billion shares.
Average daily volume rose to 22.1 million shares in 1996 from 20.1 million the previous year.
The exchange said the total dollar value of shares traded reached about $90 billion, the fourth consecutive record high. In 1995, the total value of shares traded was $72.7 billion.
The average daily dollar value of shares traded in 1996 was more than $358 million, compared with $288 million in 1995.
The exchange said 73 operating companies were listed this year against 52 companies in 1995.
"The number listed this year ...represented the best level of new operating company listings in a decade," it said.
